g.text: Objective: refresh the Damodaran industry and country benchmarks for one (region, year); the unit is the run of eight files, not a company.
back to the refresh board

text.tspan: weekly.sh
runs bot refresh --all
Damodaran datasets
pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/pc/datasets/
the refresh command starts with --all
wacc.xls, ctryprem.xls, then the six others into --download-dir
a failure of one of the first two stops the downloads
the Damodaran files are downloaded
the files that arrived go on to be read
the industry files are read
each sheet is picked by keywords; columns are read by exact header
one row per industry
outer join on industry name; the earlier file wins, a later file fills only empty columns
rows without an industry name are dropped
the country rows are read
sheet 'ERPs by country', two tables: the Moody's-rated countries, then the unrated countries scored by PRS (Political Risk Services), each read with its own columns; erp_basis says which
the derived columns are filled in
debt to equity (D/E): D/E = w ÷ (1 − w), with w = D/(D+E); empty unless 0 ≤ w < 1
beta_unlevered = beta_levered ÷ (1 + (1 − tax) × D/E), tax = the industry's tax rate; a missing tax counts as 0; empty when D/E is empty
country tax rate: sheet 'Country Tax Rates', rows outside [0, 1] are skipped
the Damodaran tables are written
replaces the (region, year) rows of damodaran_industry and the year rows of damodaran_country
one refresh_log row, status success or partial
the Damodaran run fails and writes nothing
one refresh_log row, status error, with the message

g.text: the fundamentals stage loads the industry mapping
damodaran_industry
damodaran_country
refresh_log

text.tspan: Comes out:
one damodaran_industry row per industry for (region, year), with D/E and beta_unlevered, and one damodaran_country row per country for the year

g.text: bot refresh --all
eight .xls files, one request each

text.tspan: the eight files download
[every download succeeds]
the files download without one of the six others [its download fails]
the run is partial, without that file's columns

g.text: the run stops [wacc.xls or ctryprem.xls fails to download]

text.tspan: the industry files are read
[every file can be read]
the industry files are read without one of the six others [it cannot be read]
the run is partial, without that file's columns

g.text: the run stops [wacc.xls cannot be read]
the industry files are joined on the industry name [the earlier file wins a shared column]
the country risk sheet is read
the run stops [ctryprem.xls cannot be read]
debt-to-equity, unlevered beta and country tax rates are filled in
both tables are replaced for the year in one transaction [industry and country rows exist]
only the country table is replaced, the run is partial [no industry rows]
only the industry table is replaced, the run is partial [no country rows]
the fundamentals stage starts
the fundamentals stage starts [a Damodaran failure does not stop the command]
industry benchmarks
country risk, tax rate
one row, source damodaran, status success or partial
one row, status error, with the message
the rows of the year
